title: $2000 AliExpress Carbon Superbike… Full Build Process!

takeaways.text: Check the supplied compression plug and headset preload carefully before cutting the steerer; the build otherwise went together with standard tools.

Routing mechanical housing through the integrated bar: exiting the brake housings at the front of the stem pinched them on the turn into the head tube, so he re-routed all housings to the rear stem exit, costing two to three hours.
The finished bike with mechanical groupset, GP5000 tires and AliExpress-sourced parts weighed 8.57 kg.

disclosure: Owner build video of the presenter's own custom-painted Falath Pro 2022 disc frameset, identified in the creator's chapter list; no supply relationship is stated.
summary: Home build of a Falath Pro 2022 disc frameset with mechanical shifting routed through the integrated cockpit, ending in a weigh-in.
